title: Browser permission failures escape without any user-visible error
reasoning: handleOpenBrowser awaits requestPermission inside a try/finally but has no catch. Because the click handler deliberately discards the promise with void, any rejection from the IPC/store request becomes an unhandled rejection and the settings page does not set a remediation or error message for the user. The button is re-enabled in finally, but the failure path is effectively silent except for global console/runtime handling.
recommendation: Catch requestPermission failures in handleOpenBrowser and surface a local status/error message, or route the error into the permission store error state in a way this component already renders.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for the browser settings action or permission request failure path.
suggestedRegressionTest: Render BrowserSettingsTab with a mocked permission store whose requestPermission rejects, click Open Windie Browser, and assert that a user-visible error is rendered and no unhandled rejection occurs.
minimumFixScope: BrowserSettingsTab handleOpenBrowser failure handling plus a focused component test.
